component.name: Helicon
component.summary: Desktop app for the Muse Code CLI

description.p: Helicon is a desktop app for Meta's Muse Code CLI. It runs the muse command you already have and shows its work as threads you can scroll, search and come back to, with tool approvals, file diffs and the cost of each thread laid out next to the conversation.

Helicon needs the muse command installed and signed in on this computer. In the Flatpak it reaches that command through the host, so it asks for permission to run host commands and to read your home folder. Helicon is an independent project and is not affiliated with Meta.

ul.li: Work in several folders and threads at once, and pick a thread up where you left it
Read each tool call before it runs, and approve or decline it
See the files a thread changed as diffs, in the place the edit happened
